lines.text: Off the record, I like the red one.

data.define: Said when you share information that shouldn't be repeated.

example.text: Off the record, I like the red one.

misuse.text: Don't repeat what was said 'off the record'.
misuse.why: It was shared as a secret.

publish.title: What does "off the record" mean?
publish.value: Off the record = Private, not to be shared. Example: "Off the record, I like the red one." (casual English).
